content:
Here are the growing conditions for Ageratina herbacea seeds:

• **Temperature:** 15-25°C
• **Hydrometry:** 65-75%
• **Sunshine:** 4-6 hours
• **Rainfall:** 800-1200mm
• **Humidity:** 60-70%
• **Soil:** Well-drained loam
• **Climate:** Temperate subtropical
